stem:
Students designed an experiment to model the carbon cycle. The students combined water and carbon dioxide-producing disks in a sealed flask. The flask represented Earth's atmosphere, and the lamp represented the sun. Their design is shown.

Which component can be added to the flask to reduce the concentration of carbon dioxide in the model atmosphere created by the disks?

options.label: F
options.text: Bacteria to use carbon during nitrification

options.label: G
options.text: Plants to absorb carbon in the process of photosynthesis

options.label: H
options.text: Snails to use carbon through cellular respiration

options.label: J
options.text: Mushrooms to absorb carbon during decomposition

visual_elements: Diagram showing lamp, rubber stopper, Erlenmeyer flask, carbon dioxide-producing disks, and 20 mL water
